biotools.summary: CRAmed is an R package designed for high-dimensional mediation analysis in sparse microbiome data. It provides a novel statistical framework for inferring the mediating role of the microbiome between treatment and outcome, improving interpretability and demonstrating superior performance compared to existing methods.
